report: Read all 52 candidate groups against the verses. Every multi-treatment bucket is licensed by the ASV's own wording: waw connectives (And/and/but/Now/then/therefore/yet/So/whereof/When/and when) follow rule 14/17/55 and the unrepresented waws (13.2 opening, 13.10 apodosis before behold) are places the ASV writes no connective; articles on toponyms (Gilgal, Jordan) and assimilated articles take a written the or go unrepresented exactly as the ASV writes or omits it; the anarthrous gentilic פְּלִשְׁתִּים takes a supplied the in every verse where no article morpheme stands (13.3, 4, 5, 11, 12, 16, 17, 19, 23) and leaves the the to the article where one does (13.20).

The rule-45 frame is divided consistently: 13.10 keeps the that inside the frame (written ahead of the temporal clause) and leaves the apodosis waw unrepresented; 13.22 writes the that at the apodosis head and gives it to that waw. Both are what rule 45 directs.

The chapter's added units were read end to end against the folded cases: 13.3 'of it', 13.4 the two supplied that's, 13.7 'some of' and 'as for', 13.8 'had appointed', 13.19 'them', 13.21 'they'. Each answers to no morpheme, and none is folded elsewhere in a comparable construction (the 'him' of 13.2 and 13.14 realizes a written suffix; 13.15 'gat him up' is the ASV's idiom for עָלָה and is noted as such with the competing reading named).

BSB disagreements are all documented convention differences: reflexive/dative לְ silenced by the recasting (rule 40), לְ of לֵאמֹר (rule 27), object markers (rule 16), articles on toponyms and before bare nouns the ASV writes indefinitely (rule 29), and בְּ silenced by 'blew the trumpet' (rule 40). The two lexical ones in 13.21 (פִים and שְׁלֹשׁ) are the ASV's reading of a text its own margin calls obscure — it writes 'a file' with no price and 'forks' with no numeral — and are translation differences, not alignment errors. No edge was changed for the aggregate.

Verse-level judgments already carry their competing readings in notes (13.7 followed/אַחַר, 13.10 head of 'as soon as', 13.15 'gat him up', 13.21 'they'); none is a cross-verse split. Nothing taught here generalises beyond rules the contract already states, so no conventions, promotions or amendments.
